blocks.text: A serving Seoul police officer has been detained on suspicion of creating and distributing hundreds of AI-generated sexually explicit deepfakes and possessing about 5,600 illegal sexual images and videos, including child sexual exploitation material, local media reported Sunday. The officer, assigned to the traffic division of Dongdaemun Police Station in eastern Seoul, was detained in September on allegations including possession of sexual exploitation material and fabricated sexual content, as well as producing and distributing sexually explicit deepfakes.
